title: Generative AI and Its Impact on Personalized Intelligent Tutoring Systems
extended_summary:
This paper examines how generative artificial intelligence, especially large language models such as GPT-4 and ChatGPT, can be integrated into intelligent tutoring systems (ITS) to make learning more personalized, adaptive, and interactive. Rather than reporting a primary empirical study, it synthesizes recent work and use cases around automated question generation, personalized feedback, and conversational tutoring dialogue. The central problem addressed is how generative AI can overcome limitations of traditional ITS that rely on static content and rule-based adaptation.

The paper discusses the kinds of capabilities generative AI adds to ITS, including generating questions tailored to learner proficiency, producing step-by-step feedback for errors, and sustaining natural-language tutoring conversations. It also highlights key implementation challenges, such as pedagogical accuracy, bias, equity, and learner engagement, and argues for hybrid systems with validation and expert oversight. Future directions include multimodal AI, affective computing, and ethical policy development.

The paper does not study a specific student population or educational setting; instead, it is a conceptual and review-style discussion aimed at the broader educational technology and ITS community. Its main conclusion is that generative AI has substantial promise for improving personalization and responsiveness in tutoring systems, but that responsible deployment requires safeguards for correctness, fairness, and sustained engagement.
quality_tier_rationale: This is a narrative conceptual report/review, not an empirical study. It does not present a defined sample, comparison group, or outcome analysis, so it provides no causal or correlational evidence under the evidence framework.
impact_tier_rationale: No measured impact is reported. The paper argues for potential benefits of generative AI in tutoring systems, but it provides no effect sizes or student outcome data.

interventions.use_case: Generative AI/LLM-enhanced intelligent tutoring systems that generate personalized questions, provide real-time step-by-step feedback, and support interactive dialogue tutoring (e.g., GPT-4 in ITS).
A conceptual review of classical adaptive tutoring systems as the base architecture being augmented by generative AI for personalization and feedback.
